Diego M (Billing): Heads-up: customer Nimbus Labs invoice #A-452 failed card auth this morning (decline_code: do_not_honor). Trying automated retry now.
Harper F (Finance): Do we have a secondary payment method?
Diego M (Billing): No fallback on file. Net-30 customer, medium ARR. No prior history.
Lou C (CS): I pinged contact; they said theyare traveling and can't access their procurement tools until Monday. They asked if we can open a one-time invoice link or accept ACH.
payments-bot: Stripe event: {"type":"payment_intent.payment_failed","code":"do_not_honor","amount":"95000"} posted.
Diego M (Billing): Suggested approach: 1) schedule 2 retries (24h), 2) send one-time secure pay link, 3) allow service to continue for 72h before restriction. Anyone object?
Harper F (Finance): Sounds reasonable. Document the extension and mark invoice A-452 as "grace period". If unpaid after 72h escalate to me.
Lou C (CS): I'll send the secure link and call the finance contact. If they canpay by card over the phone we can collect immediately.
Diego M (Billing): Created note on account and scheduled retries. Added label: "card_decline - grace 72h".
Harper F (Finance): Also flag for follow-up about adding ACH or backup card. Thanks.
Lou C (CS): Update: they accepted the secure link and will attempt payment in ~30m. I'll post here after confirmation.
payments-bot: Charge succeeded for invoice A-452 (amount 950.00 USD)
Diego M (Billing): Payment confirmed. Closing thread.
